_comment: REAL misattributions, adjudicated 2026-08-04 — the checker is RIGHT about every entry here. This is NOT the allowlist: nothing in this file is a false positive. It exists only so a known backlog does not block unrelated work while it burns down, and it is what makes --gate-absent a ratchet: a citation added tomorrow with the same defect fails immediately, because it is not in here.
_rule: DO NOT ADD TO THIS FILE. Fix the row instead — re-source it, or drop the number. Delete the entry when you do; --gate-absent reports entries that are no longer flagged.

_found: 2026-08-04 — 178 findings across 153 citations and 124 substances. Spot-checked examples: Salvinorin A's KOR affinity cited to a radiohalogenated PSMA prostate-imaging paper; Tranylcypromine's LSD1 to a survey of cadmium-contaminated bacterial phylotypes; harmine/harmaline/tetrahydroharmine half-lives to an HIV-cytokine immunology paper. The 'the paper is about the receptor, not the drug' defence explains only 3 of the 178.
